name: MySneakyLink
tagline: Infrastructure work on a Next.js codebase: the move into src, GitHub Actions CI/CD, a Vercel deploy check with a rollback target, and typed schema and prompt utilities.
overview: MySneakyLink is a Next.js project where Jackson's work appears focused on project infrastructure, repository organization, CI/CD, deployment checks, lint/type cleanup, schema utilities, and prompt utilities. This page emphasizes engineering infrastructure rather than product ownership unless additional product commits are verified.
